HV.note: Mains-referenced / switched power. DC_BUS_RTN (dc_bus_minus) and PWR_RTN (power_return, doubler midpoint) are HV per elec/domain_manifest.yaml, not SELV returns. Isolation barrier to SELV required across every copper layer; a declared boundary or distance check alone is not a barrier (CONCEPTS.md).

SELV_LV.note: Aux 15V from PS1 (IRM-10-15, isolated) feeds buck VIN; buck 3V3 feeds MCU VCC3V3. gnd and PWR_RTN are separate compiled nets (star-join short removed); the single LV return tie claim for this section is a U2 wiring obligation, not a measured board fact.

signal.note: SELV-referenced control/sense. No new HV/LV crossing is introduced by this section.

reconciled_contradictions: Ordinal layer IDs (0/3/1/2/4/31) do not encode physical order; resolved to the setup/stackup sequence F/In3/In1/In2/In4/B with thicknesses above.
Two-layer buck prototype settings (50x40mm, 1.6mm FR-4, 1oz, HASL) do NOT transfer; target is six-layer 164x234mm ENIG above.
Prototype J1/J2/TP1-TP4/H1-H4 are fixtures, excluded from the functional nine (U3/L2/C9/C10/C11/C12/C13/R16/R17).
Samsung capacitor update (CL32B106KBJZW6E / CL32B226KAJNNWE) postdates older receipts; U2 uses current bytes via source-manifest, not a copied digest.
Net-name spellings (+3V3 vs 3V3, gnd vs GND) are aliases resolved by canonical source identity in U2, not by string match.

replacement_ledger.verify_then_remove: Target passives inside buck_block/mcu_block that U2 binds to a BuckConverter3V3/MCU source instance; each removal must verify the object existed in the baseline and retain before/after identity.
replacement_ledger.retain: All geometry outside the owned boundary envelopes; shared +3V3/gnd nets are cut only at envelope endpoints, never deleted by net name.

owned_envelopes_mm.rule: One envelope per owned instance (19 total: 9 buck + 10 mcu), each centered on its measured native (at). Passives/U3 use at +/-5mm (covers 0603/1210 bodies, pads, and local copper); L2 uses +/-8mm (SRP1265A body); U27 uses its 18.0x25.5 body rect at rot 90 (25.5 along x). The prior two-box scheme (mcu 18-52x28-68, buck 100-146x132-162) covered only U3/L2/U27 and left all 16 scattered passives outside owned scope. R74's box touches the board outline edge (x2 172.0); that is its measured position, not an extension. C40/C41/R72 envelopes are provisional on U2 confirming the binding.

replacement_ledger.boundary_rule: Cut/reconnect shared or crossing nets only at explicit envelope endpoints with continuity rechecked after insertion. A crossing that cannot be replaced within scope is a named interface blocker (interfaces.json), not permission to reroute unrelated circuits.
